macros.name: beginmarkversion
macros.doc: \beginmarkversion and \endmarkversion is the style of marks surrounding environments ‘〈version〉’ after \markversion{〈version〉}.

macros.name: includeversionnogroup
macros.doc: provides a user command \includeversionnogroup{〈version〉} working like \includeversion{〈version〉}, but included ‘〈version〉’ will form no grouping.

macros.name: versionmessage
macros.doc: \versionmessage is the style of screen reports from \excludeversion etc. Any redefinition must use two arguments.
